command:
i=4
    for a in B A; do
      i=$((i + 1)); bin=<bins>/memra-server-fa0ee88acf; [ "$a" = B ] && bin=<bins>/memra-server-merge-fa0ee88acf-3448243319
      echo "$(TZ=Asia/Jerusalem date "+%F %T") steady $i $a start" | tee -a <lane>/out/campaign.log
      bash <lane>/arm-steady.sh "steady-$i-$a" "$bin" <lane>/out MEMRA_MAX_SESSIONS=12
      echo "$(TZ=Asia/Jerusalem date "+%F %T") steady $i $a rc=$? $(grep -a "oom_lines\|reclaim_on_defer_lines\|thermal stop" <lane>/out/steady-$i-$a/arm.txt | tr "\n" " ")" | tee -a <lane>/out/campaign.log
      grep -q "thermal stop" <lane>/out/steady-$i-$a/arm.txt && exit 143
    done
    exit 0
